module_summary: Four-entry 4-bit LIFO stack: a stack pointer indexes a register array, pushes decrement and pops increment it under EN/RW control, with FULL/EMPTY derived from the pointer.

anchors.name: stack_mem
anchors.why: Four-entry stack array written on push, read on pop.

anchors.name: SP
anchors.why: Stack pointer indexing stack_mem; derives FULL and EMPTY.

anchors.name: EN
anchors.why: Enables all buffer operations including reset.

anchors.name: EMPTY
anchors.why: Empty flag from SP[2]; blocks pops.

anchors.name: FULL
anchors.why: Full flag when SP is zero; blocks pushes.

groups.name: Stack memory
groups.description: Register array storing pushed entries, popped to dataOut.

groups.name: Stack control
groups.description: Stack pointer update and full/empty flags under EN/RW.
